about_the_game:
LED Bringer is a narrative-driven top-down action game set on a planet where the sun has gone dark, and the surface lies in near-total shadow. After a catastrophic crash, the lander's AI detects that its human pilot is critically injured. With no other options, it constructs a combat-ready drone — your character — to defend the lander, explore the planet, and ensure the survival of its only human occupant.

You are alone, but not powerless. Using energy drawn from the lander’s reactor, you'll expand a network of artificial light in the surrounding darkness, pushing back the shadows one beacon at a time. But the planet is far from abandoned. Scavenger goblins, wearing makeshift armor and wielding salvaged tech from the ruins of other crashed ships, are drawn to your fragile light.

As the drone, you'll fight to survive, gather resources, and build infrastructure — from temporary power relays to permanent light towers. But not all creatures on this planet are hostile. One old goblin still remembers a time when the world was warm, and light was natural. He may hold the key to stopping the revolution led by the new goblin chief — a tyrant who has collected deadly technology and now rules the region like a warlord.

Features:

  • Take control of a combat drone created by a stranded lander AI

  • Build a network of light in a hostile, sunless world

  • Explore mysterious biomes filled with environmental storytelling

  • Battle scavenger goblins using modular weapons: firebolts, dashes, beams, and more

  • Upgrade your systems and expand your range with careful power management

  • Uncover the secrets of the planet and the origins of its fall into darkness

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 3200U / Intel Core i3-8100
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 6600 / NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super
  • Storage: 4000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Zgodna z DirectX

short_description: The sun has gone out, and darkness has consumed the planet. You ended up here by accident, but now you must become a glimmer of hope. Even if it's just… an LED. Take control of a combat drone, expand your base, navigate the darkness, and uncover the secrets of a dying world.
